lines.text: The people under siege are told to gather their belongings, for the LORD will sling them out of the land.
The speaker's tent is destroyed, all its ropes are snapped, and his sons have departed from him.
The shepherds have become senseless and do not seek the LORD, so all their sheep are scattered.
A great commotion is coming from the land to the south, and Judah's cities will become a haunt for jackals.
The prayer asks the LORD to correct only with justice, and to pour out His wrath on the nations.
